items.title: Vuzix Signs Reseller Agreement with Friends With Holograms to Support Enterprise Smart Glasses Adoption
items.summary: Vuzix® Corporation (NASDAQ: VUZI), ("Vuzix" or, the "Company"), a supplier of AI-powered smart glasses, waveguides for smart glasses and co-packaged optical data center interconnects, and related augmented reality technologies, today announced that it has entered into a reseller agreement with Friends With Holograms, a New York-based company that helps enterprises identify, develop and deploy smart glasses and spatial computing solutions.
